title: Deep-learning B-line ratings show 2-zone lung ultrasound matches 8-zone in heart failure
summary: A previously published deep-learning algorithm rating B-line severity from 0 to 4 was adapted to hand-held ultrasound videos from a prospective study of 205 subjects (5728 videos). Bland-Altman analysis showed excellent agreement between 2-zone and 8-zone averages, with a mean absolute difference of 0.03 (95% CI -0.01 to 0.07) overall and 0.01 in the confirmed heart-failure subgroup (147 subjects).
ai_technology: Previously published deep-learning algorithm rating B-line severity on ultrasound videos

evidence.tested: Agreement analysis of existing prospectively collected videos.
evidence.unknown: Agreement of protocols, not diagnostic accuracy; algorithm pre-existing; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: DL provides consistent severity ratings across zones.
